scientific_integrity: Analytical facet-distance and strictly convex crossover proofs; separately executed finite linear-program checks corroborate but do not replace proof. Historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Requires n>=2 and positive integer b; original ambient Euclidean metric. Simultaneous multiple-rank ties and general continuous parameter degeneracies are not classified. Independent audit has not been performed.
title: Every subset rank can be the sole upper inball-contact orbit of a generalized parking-function polytope
